data.body:
[P2] Include run ownership when creating a quarantine

If standalone `settle` fails without an existing quarantine, this writes only `error`. Subsequent successful recovery cannot remove that record because `Cloud.settle_run()` requires its `run` to match the manifest. Later example runs therefore remain blocked in the same checkout even after verified settlement. When the manifest was successfully loaded, include its run identity in newly created quarantines while preserving existing ownership. Add a regression covering failed standalone settlement followed by successful recovery.
